prompt:
Use case: identity-preserve, style-transfer.
Image 1 is identity reference Anni / 安妮 / ASH-NPC-ANNI. Redraw this same woman as an adult low-resolution dialogue portrait. She is in her twenties, an ordinary caregiver who takes responsibility for one bounded real shift and makes her availability clear. Preserve warm light-medium complexion, chestnut-brown side-part hair gathered into a LOW BUN visible behind viewer-left side, pronounced adult brows and her recognizable three-quarter face turned slightly toward viewer right. Self-possessed matter-of-fact alert expression, almost level brows with a tiny explanatory asymmetry; lips slightly parted without bright teeth. Not a child, no doll face, not middle-aged, no glamour smile or helpless anxiety template.
IDENTITY / LATEST CARD: Plain cream-gray nursing-shift robe with restrained gray seam and tiny brown fastening detail, visible only as a narrow collar strip. Hairline, low bun and ear must remain entire. Hair is chestnut-brown, not black or blonde. The green waist tie, sleeve buckles, scissors, cloth strips, shift tag and notebook are outside this tight head framing and should NOT be moved to her head or neck. Ordinary caretaker, not a doctor, nun, saint or military medic. No claim of healing, year-round availability, accepted next shift or research consent.
COMPOSITION: Extremely tight head-and-tiny-collar portrait. Design as a logical 74 by 100 pixel canvas. Forehead-to-chin facial mass dominates the image, chin around row 86–89, only 3–5 logical pixels of supporting neck, a narrow collar strip below. No bust, chest or broad shoulders. Preserve the ENTIRE crown, all hair/headcloth extremities and ear silhouette with real transparent clearance of at least 3 logical pixels on left, right, top and bottom. Do not crop the source silhouette at the canvas edges.
PIXEL STYLE: Match images 2–5, Mara / Iwo / Leiya / Tore, for chunky low-resolution face structure and hard edges only. They are style references, never identities to copy. Broad angular connected forehead, nose bridge, cheekbone and jaw color planes, strongly readable nose and cheekbones. Limited earthy colors, no more than 32 flat working colors. Small narrow dark adult eyes, one or two DARK beige-gray pixels at most for sclera, always darker than the lit cheeks. No bright white eye triangles or catchlights. Hair/cloth in three or four broad connected masses, not fine comb stripes. Every feature should survive viewing at 74 by 100. Deliberate hard-edged pixel clusters, no gradients, anti-aliasing, blur, soft painting, dithering or speckled texture.
OUTPUT: One portrait only, genuine transparent background. No text, numbers, frame, swatches, hands, tools, scenery or other people. Make a substantive fresh image-generated portrait, not a resized crop of the full-body source.
